additional_info.subject: ID0390375-DC/Si-D/RO-[MP / P1 170000127] Offline on SCB CRM:00921001279
additional_info.body:
Hi Traian, good afternoon.
After our site visit today, we were able to bring the charger online again. When we got to site, we troubleshooted the router 1 to see if there was any problem.
What we noticed is that the Connection status was: “Connected”, there was some data transfer but it stopped.
When we tried to Re-register/Restart Connection, we got status “Disconnected” so I believe the first was sort of a false positive.
When we did Reboot modem, we got Connected but SCB connection was not being established.
When we reboot the whole charger it worked again.
I didn't have SSH access so we postponed doing a factory reset of the router since it might leave the charger inoperational again.
My recommendation is to order a new router and if the customer faces any issue to report to you before rebooting.
When you have time to go there again, let's align with me doing the factory reset, if it works and the charger comes online, let's monitor it and request the customer to perform reboots every week (for example) and if there is no more problem then it's solved. Otherwise, if after another reboot after the factory reset it happens again, then let's replace the router.
Let me know if I missed something and keep messaging me in Teams for further instructions. Also bring a Ethernet cable next time :D
Best regards,
Francisco
